CA.rationale: No attention/allocation relation to content present.

COD.rationale: Content (red set), its presentation (coordinate set), and a separate origin/status field are all present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to a content's organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple named records list identified content sets with color attributes and coordinates.

D.rationale: Content coordinates and a separate origin/status field are both recorded for the same item, distinguishing identity from status/source.

O.rationale: The report states coordinate-axis orientation and shows organized coordinate sets for items, describing presentation/organization.
